Working from a spare bedroom for nine hours a day changes how a house gets used and how it should be cleaned. The desk, the keyboard, the doorknob you touch between calls, and the air you breathe all day are within a few feet of each other. That is why professionals in Greer ask about eco friendly cleaning in Greer: not as a trend, but because they spend more of their day at home than they used to.

Our products or yours: a quick comparison

ChoiceGood forKeep in mind
Our low-odor productsHouseholds with children, pets or mild fragrance sensitivityAvailable on request; we confirm at the estimate
Fragrance-free optionAllergy and asthma sufferers, people who work from homeThe scent of "clean" will be mild or absent
Your own productsAnyone with a specific brand or ingredient listTell us where they are stored and which surfaces they are for

Whichever you pick, the room-by-room checklist stays the same. Only the product and the technique change.

The technique matters as much as the product

We wipe by hand and use microfiber cloths that capture dust instead of spreading it. That is a small difference you can see: the next day, the surface of the desk and the monitor stand is still clean and not covered in fine dust again. Our hand-wiping technique also reduces the amount of product used, which helps in a small home office where odors collect.

The areas we pay attention to in a working household:

  • The desk area, cable runs and the floor around the chair.
  • Door handles, light switches and shared surfaces in the kitchen.
  • Kitchen counters where lunches are prepared on the days you are home.
  • Bathrooms, which take the most time because soap scum needs patience with gentle products.
  • Vents and baseboards, where dust collects when the heat is running.

How long it takes, and booking this week

Expect a first visit to run longer than later ones, because gentle products need more time on built-up soap scum and cooked-on grease. After the estimate, we give you a range. If you want to start before the holidays, ask for the next open weekday and say whether you will be home. Many people in Greer who work remotely prefer to leave the house for the visit, and we can work either way.

What changes with allergy season and the Upstate climate

Spring pollen is real in the Upstate, and humid summers bring mildew into bathrooms. Cold months mean windows stay shut and dust stays inside. A green plan handles each differently: more attention to window sills and vents in spring, more bathroom detail in summer, and more floor and baseboard work in winter. Greer homes also range from older houses near Downtown Greer and Trade Street to newer ones near GSP Airport and the BMW plant, so the dust patterns differ.

Setting up a routine around your calendar

A green plan works best when it matches how you actually use the house. If you work from home Monday through Wednesday and travel the rest of the week, schedule the visit on a travel day so the house is empty and quiet. If you have video calls, tell us which room to leave for last. If you are away for long stretches, a monthly visit may be enough, though you will want a bathroom and kitchen refresh after a trip. A recurring plan also means the team learns the house: which cabinet sticks, which floor needs a different pad, which windowsill collects the most dust. That knowledge is worth more than any single product, and it is what makes later visits faster and more thorough.

We also suggest keeping one shelf for cleaning supplies you want us to use, labeled and out of reach of children, so there is no confusion at the start of the visit.

If you are weighing green cleaning against a standard service, ask for the walkthrough before deciding. We can show you which products would be used in which rooms and explain where gentler methods work as well as stronger ones, and where they take longer. You will leave the visit with a clear idea of what the first clean will involve and what a regular plan would look like, with no commitment. Bring your questions about ingredients and any allergy notes from your doctor, and we will write them into the plan so every team member sees them.
